axes.name: Legal-effect class
axes.values: The ten ratified constitutional taxonomy classes, class-01 through class-10
axes.note: An author-chosen planning grammar, not derived and not exhaustive; preserved as its own axis and never reused as the domain axis.

axes.name: Social domain
axes.values: The twelve-cluster minimum inventory, FS-DOM-01 through FS-DOM-12
axes.note: Answers which part of life is involved and where its decisions belong; orthogonal to the legal-effect class.

axes.name: Layer (scope disposition)
axes.values: The five ratified routing dispositions, stored under the scope_disposition key
axes.note: One enum, one key. These five values are the reader-facing five-layer society map, author-ratified 2026-08-09. A leaf record carries exactly one; a domain record spans all five as its buckets.

axes.name: Claim posture
axes.values: Derived, Checked, Evidenced, Specified, Reasoned, Unestablished
axes.note: One posture per claim record; a record that would carry two is two records.

axes.name: Assurance route
axes.values: The seven ratified routes, FS-RTE-01 through FS-RTE-07
axes.note: A route establishes what it executes, over what it was given, and nothing further; one green route never stands in for another.

axes.name: Assurance overlay
axes.note: A liveness claim is never established today; a feasibility claim may not appear in Book 1 at all.

axes.name: Defect disposition
axes.values: The closed seven-value enum; the last three are explicit non-resolution boundaries
axes.note: Answers what the design did about a known failure; orthogonal to posture, route, overlay, class, and domain.

axes.name: Response stage
axes.note: Route-relative, not a universal total order; a stage supplies no assurance by itself.

scope_disposition_meanings.constitutional-invariant: The condition is guaranteed or refused by the constitution itself; no tier, majority, emergency, or remedy may lower it.
scope_disposition_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: A decision left to ordinary majorities inside the ratified corridor; the constitution bounds it without choosing it.
scope_disposition_meanings.protected-private-civic-freedom: A protected private or civic choice; an explicit non-prescription or non-interference disposition counts as coverage and authorises no rule, record, operator, or success certification.
scope_disposition_meanings.book-2-operation: Owned by Book 2: staffing, costs, capacity, resources, technology, workflows, transition, deployment, and operation under ordinary and declared shock conditions.
scope_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: A premise outside both books: named, owned, falsifiable, and never laundered into an established claim.

gate_applicability_meanings.gate-a: versioned scope map and assurance test program
gate_applicability_meanings.gate-d: Book 2 operational model in a calibrated envelope

routing_marker_meanings.not-constitutionally-prescribed: The bucket is deliberately empty of constitutional content; the absence is the disposition, checked for rights harm, concentrated power, public duty, and commons effects.
routing_marker_meanings.democratic-ordinary-law-choice: The bucket's content is chosen by ordinary law inside the corridor.
routing_marker_meanings.book-2-operation: The bucket's content is routed to Book 2 as operation.
routing_marker_meanings.external-assumption: The bucket's content rests on a named external premise.

posture_meanings.Derived: An executable engine result over the exact current source, or over a named bounded mutation declared in a fixture or reviewed audit.
posture_meanings.Checked: A mechanical check establishing a property of the artifacts, never of the world and never a semantic impossibility.
posture_meanings.Evidenced: A claim about the world with population, period, place, and method.
posture_meanings.Specified: A complete contract, stated but not formalised; carries an explicit unimplemented marker.
posture_meanings.Reasoned: Argument against a named adversarial corpus; permanently weaker than Derived and never citable as it.
posture_meanings.Unestablished: Not established; carries exactly one named disposition.

unestablished_disposition_meanings.routed-book-2: Routed to Book 2; routing is a disposition, not assurance.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.external-assumption: Rests on a named external premise with owner and falsifier.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.route-unbuilt: Its only route is neither built nor available; carries severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, and a public-claim restriction.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.evidence-pending: Its route is built or available, but no admitted evidence currently establishes the claim; any valid failure remains recorded as failure and is never rewritten as not run.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.author-ruling-pending: Waits for a named author ruling; briefs may proceed, dependent work may not.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.refused: Deliberately refused by a standing ruling.
unestablished_disposition_meanings.not-establishable: No route could establish it as stated; the claim must narrow or stay unmade.

evidence_kind_meanings.executable: The pin suites and the record, temporal, amendment, placement, and counterfactual runs; the only kind that warrants Derived.
evidence_kind_meanings.pattern-guard: A guard that reads spelling or structure; a pattern guard is not a proof.
evidence_kind_meanings.freshness: A generator --check mode or staleness gate; currency, not truth.
evidence_kind_meanings.inventory: A reviewed operation set, record class, or scenario narrative; a reviewed threat model, explicitly not executable proof.

overlay_meanings.safety: May be Derived with a supplied-records scope bound and an enumerated non-extension clause.
overlay_meanings.liveness: Arrival, advance, action, release, delivery, repair; never Derived, Checked, or Reasoned; Unestablished until operational assurance exists.
overlay_meanings.feasibility: Needs models or simulations plus operational assurance; may not be written in Book 1 at all.
overlay_meanings.none: The claim asserts routing, structure, or method rather than a safety, liveness, or feasibility property.

route_status_meanings.built: Its check exists and runs in verify.sh.
route_status_meanings.available: Its evidence contract, admissibility criteria, named reviewer, and in-repo gate exist so outside evidence can be admitted.
route_status_meanings.unbuilt: Neither built nor available; naming a route does not build it.

defect_disposition_meanings.eliminated-structurally: The failure-producing route no longer exists in the declared model; the repaired source must refuse the former result for the intended reason.
defect_disposition_meanings.prevented: The initiating failure cannot arise within the named scope.
defect_disposition_meanings.protected-consequence-contained: The initiating failure may arise, but the named protected consequence cannot cross the stated boundary.
defect_disposition_meanings.remedied: After harm occurs, an evidenced route restores the protected condition; never proves prevention.
defect_disposition_meanings.externally-bounded-assumption: Closure depends on a premise outside the model; explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
defect_disposition_meanings.irreducible-limitation: The chosen model cannot close the failure without contradicting a settled boundary; honest limitation is not resolution.

response_stage_meanings.detected: The failure has a visible, attributable witness; nothing is yet specified, implemented, prevented, repaired, recovered, or resolved.
response_stage_meanings.interface-specified: Book 1 assigns a duty, evidence, continuity, challenge, or remedy interface, but no implemented route establishes its effect.
response_stage_meanings.implemented-in-assigned-route: The response exists in its assigned route; the stage supplies no assurance.
response_stage_meanings.operationally-assured-in-envelope: A staffed, costed, accountable route is exercised end to end in the named test setting; supports only the reproducible operational-design claim for that envelope.

resolution_status_meanings.resolved-for-claim: Generated only: the affected claim's ceiling, disposition, stage, route, and evidence jointly permit resolution for that claim alone.
resolution_status_meanings.unresolved-for-claim: Generated only: the default; detected, specified, assigned, implemented, disclosed, and understood are not synonyms for resolved.

proposal_disposition_meanings.added: The proposal entered the canonical source as records.
proposal_disposition_meanings.classified-out: Classified with reasons under the ratified dispositions or as duplicate or immaterial, carrying the matching Unestablished disposition.
proposal_disposition_meanings.retained-limit: Retained as an unresolved severity-rated limit with owner and closure condition.

envelope_status_meanings.stub: The permanent pre-envelope identity: records keyed before the envelope was versioned cite it; it can route, never assure.
envelope_status_meanings.versioned-structure: Fields, definitions, dependents, and invariance statements are versioned and reviewable; no value exists. This satisfies Gate A's envelope precondition, while operational assurance and remedied resolution still require calibration.
envelope_status_meanings.calibrated: Values calibrated and validated by Book 2 at Gate D. Refused outright in this contract: calibration becomes legal only through a deliberate future contract amendment.

value_status_meanings.declared-pending: The field is declared without a value; calibration is Book 2's Gate D work, and no value enters Book 1.

lawful_source_meanings.constitutional-minimum-or-ceiling: The threshold's content is fixed by the constitution itself; democratic law may exceed it, never lower it.
lawful_source_meanings.democratic-policy-target: Democratic law chooses the level inside the corridor; the constitution bounds without choosing.
lawful_source_meanings.scientific-safety-boundary: An independently reviewed scientific process supplies the evidence boundary; science supplies evidence, not law.
lawful_source_meanings.operational-diagnostic: An operational measurement or adjudicated finding owned by Book 2 or an authorised external process; it diagnoses, it does not legislate.

role_kind_meanings.life-course: A stage or transition of a human life the constitution must reach — birth to death — never a capacity grade.
role_kind_meanings.care-and-dependency: A relation of giving, receiving, or supporting care; each party keeps separate standing and a separate floor.
role_kind_meanings.learning-and-culture: A position in learning, creation, belief, or the voluntary sphere; protected, never certified or ranked.
role_kind_meanings.economic: A position in work, property, exchange, or economic power; none gates the floor and labels never decide status.
role_kind_meanings.civic-political: A position in democratic choice, office, service, or civic action; one person, one equal ballot.
role_kind_meanings.membership-and-mobility: A position in residence, membership, movement, or collective belonging; presence, not paperwork, is the test.
role_kind_meanings.justice-and-coercion: A position in accusation, injury, holding, custody, or release; the prisoner is the stress test, not the default inhabitant.
role_kind_meanings.cross-cutting: A position every domain can reach — the record subject, the animal custodian — routed once, not duplicated per domain.

scale_meanings.individual: One person's own rights, choices, and remedies.
scale_meanings.household-association: Voluntary living, pooling, and associational arrangements; membership never merges standing.
scale_meanings.local: The local tier's protected competences and services.
scale_meanings.regional: The regional tier's residual authority under subsidiarity.
scale_meanings.national: The common tier's enumerated competences and guarantees.
scale_meanings.cross-jurisdictional: Movement, portability, effective control, extradition, and external relations.
scale_meanings.intergenerational: The inherited ecological capability and option-space; protected without a present-person record.

power_position_meanings.affected: The role stands under the power's decisions and bears its failure.
power_position_meanings.checking: The role holds a standing route to contest, oversee, or replace the power.

role_anchor_meanings.constitution-predicate-derived: The role's marker is a derived-only conclusion in the current constitution; nothing can write it directly.
role_anchor_meanings.constitution-predicate-asserted: The role's marker is a writable admitted relation in the current constitution; the record prose carries its replace-card path where one is ratified.
role_anchor_meanings.ratified-doctrine-unimplemented: The role rests on an author-ratified ruling not yet formalised; no predicate, rule, or remedy exists in the engine.

flow_kind_meanings.authority: Lawful mandate, delegation, command, and confidence; power moves only through its source.
flow_kind_meanings.information: Records, evidence, reasons, disclosure, and attestation; a record is routing, never proof of the world.
flow_kind_meanings.care: Care given, received, and supported; each party keeps a separate floor.
flow_kind_meanings.labour: Work sustaining functions across every ownership form; status follows reality, not labels.
flow_kind_meanings.resources: Physical and ecological inputs and capacities; scarcity is a finding, never a budget choice.
flow_kind_meanings.money: Funding, payment, and fiscal transfer; payment is never delivery.
flow_kind_meanings.claims: Initiation, challenge, relief, and remedy; a claim costs nothing and risks nothing.
flow_kind_meanings.services: Provision and operation of what people use; a promise is not an arrival.
flow_kind_meanings.accountability: Examination, oversight, review, and correction; the examiner never creates the facts it certifies.

dependency_class_meanings.constitutionally-guaranteed: The flow exists by ratified invariant and survives ordinary politics; the class names the lawful source of the obligation, never a delivery status.
dependency_class_meanings.democratically-selected: The flow is supplied by an election, confidence, enactment, budget, or mandate inside the corridor.
dependency_class_meanings.operationally-supplied: The flow rides on Book 2 operating machinery or actual private operation that does not exist yet; no body is functional because its name exists.
dependency_class_meanings.externally-assumed: The flow rests on a named external assumption; nothing internal manufactures it.

loop_kind_meanings.service: An ordinary provision-and-correction circle acting on each step's output.
loop_kind_meanings.feedback: An oversight, electoral, or review circle returning consequences to their source.
loop_kind_meanings.fiscal: The revenue, appropriation, and provision circle; deadlock mints nothing.
loop_kind_meanings.ecological: The delivery-and-regeneration circle under the two-sided bound.
loop_kind_meanings.sequence: A staged circle that unwinds in time — a sequence, not a deadlock.

lifecycle_path_meanings.right: The ratified right path: duty, accessible delivery, receipt evidence, failure, continuity, remedy, audit, correction.
lifecycle_path_meanings.power: The ratified power path: lawful trigger, bounded act, public reasons, independent review, appeal, correction or end.
lifecycle_path_meanings.record: The ratified record path: authorised basis, limited visibility, challenge, correction, assurance of the correction path.
lifecycle_path_meanings.outside-ratified-paths: The edge serves a function outside the three ratified person-facing paths; its routing fields still carry interruption, continuity, remedy, restoration, and correction.

scenario_kind_meanings.journey: An ordinary-success path through a domain: who acts, what must arrive, and what the person can do when it does not; success is the floor and the liberty holding, never a state-defined life outcome.
scenario_kind_meanings.stress: A failure or abuse path: what must not happen, what breaks first, and which recorded route catches it.
scenario_kind_meanings.collision: Two ratified goods meeting on one named axis; the record states the invariant that survives the collision, never a winner by count.
scenario_kind_meanings.compound-shock: A named whole-society shock crossing many domains at once; Book 1 states invariant and failure behaviour, and capacity and degradation stay Book 2's tests.

collision_axis_meanings.property-vs-floor: Lawful property, tenure, and credit meeting the unconditional floor; no holding or debt extinguishes another person's floor claim.
collision_axis_meanings.speech-association-vs-private-harm: Protected expression and association meeting evidenced private harm; conduct crosses the line, a label alone does not.
collision_axis_meanings.majority-vs-minority: Democratic choice meeting the corridor; no margin makes a floor-cutting or discriminatory policy lawful.
collision_axis_meanings.parent-guardian-power-vs-child-standing: Fiduciary adult power meeting the child's independent standing and growing decision-specific authority.
collision_axis_meanings.employer-landlord-platform-power-vs-mean: Concentrated private power meeting the person's real ability to leave; unavailable exit controls the transaction.
collision_axis_meanings.emergency-vs-liberty: Declared hazard powers meeting personal liberty; restriction is hazard-specific and reviewable, and its legal effect ends absent current source-bound evidence.
collision_axis_meanings.present-allocation-vs-future-commons: Present allocation meeting the inherited ecological option-space; ceilings bound the choice and a breach stays a breach.
collision_axis_meanings.locality-vs-portability: Protected local variation meeting the person's portable floor and standing; no tier lowers the common minimum.
collision_axis_meanings.privacy-vs-public-accountability: Transparency aimed at power meeting privacy owed to persons; aggregates open audit while person-level identity stays walled.
collision_axis_meanings.physical-scarcity-vs-equal-floor: Genuine physical shortage meeting equal floor claims; rationing mitigates recorded failure and never re-ranks human worth.

shock_kind_meanings.pandemic: Disease-driven declared restrictions and scarce care together; rights survive, the forbidden priority keys stay forbidden, and capacity is Book 2's test.
shock_kind_meanings.famine: Food scarcity against the equal floor; the finding is contestable, a ration is never renamed the minimum, and production is Book 2's.
shock_kind_meanings.infrastructure-failure: Records, payments, or utilities stop; duties survive their instruments, and restoring operation is Book 2 work.
shock_kind_meanings.displacement: Mass movement across borders and regions; presence within effective control carries the floor, and reception capacity is Book 2's.
shock_kind_meanings.institutional-capture: Connected offices under one controlling interest; the design reduces and exposes capture and never claims it impossible.
shock_kind_meanings.conflicting-jurisdictions: Two authorities claim one person or power; the last uncontested holder keeps it while the Court decides.

protected_sphere_form_meanings.freedom-without-permission: The protected act needs no licence, registration, or approval to be lawful.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.non-recording-non-compulsion: No record is made and no participation is compelled; absence of a record is not a gap.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.evidenced-harm-threshold: State attention begins only at the narrow, evidenced-harm threshold, never at disapproval.
protected_sphere_form_meanings.recourse-against-interference: Interference below the threshold is itself the wrong, with a recorded challenge route.

compatibility_table.resolution_requirement: An executable reintroduction mutation on the formal route, or a preregistered reintroduction, ablation, hostile, or negative control on any other route; the repaired source or system must refuse the former result for the intended reason. Resolves only the named failure in its exact model.
Route-appropriate hostile and negative controls test the initiation boundary. Resolves only the initiating-failure claim.
Bypass, composition, and negative-control cases test the exact stated boundary. Resolves only the named consequence and boundary.

Requires an Evidenced liveness claim through operational assurance, recording actor, trigger, interim continuity, restoration, challenge, recurrence control, and evidence. Resolves only the recovery claim and never proves prevention.
Name the source or authenticator, falsifier, failure consequence, owner, and public-claim restriction. Explicitly bounded is still not internally resolved.
Supply the argument, alternatives considered, residual risk, and exact claim narrowing. Honest limitation is not resolution.
Carry severity, consequence, owner, closure condition, affected claims, and blocking gate. A critical unresolved defect blocks its affected claim.

domains.title: Personhood and life course
domains.applicability: every person within jurisdiction or effective control, from birth through death
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — every other domain hangs from standing
domains.consequence: an unrouted personhood question would let a record gate a person
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for standing, adulthood, and life-course rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: Universal standing: every person counts before any other rule applies; personhood roots the floor, survives witnessed record replacement, and no tier, emergency, or remedy may remove it. A born child is an independent rights-holder; general adulthood arises automatically at one common-tier statutory age; plenary guardianship and status-based incapacity are refused.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Common-tier law chooses the single numeric adulthood age and life-course programme design inside the ratified limits; neither ruling supplies the number.

protected_private_civic.answer: Identity, self-description, and intimate life-course choices are protected from prescription, outcome certification, and social scoring.

book2_operations.answer: Registration and vital-records administration, care and family proceedings, clinical and death-record operations, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Witness production, outside record arrival, and successor production are named external assumptions (FS-EXA-02, FS-EXA-03).

scenario_applicability.answer: Life-course journeys from first contact through birth, adulthood, ageing, and succession, with dependency and standing collisions, exercise this domain's ordinary, failure, and recovery interfaces; execution is sequenced behind the relevant author rulings and contract cards.

domains.reader_destination: Chapters on evidence, standing, and the vote; the family and life-course chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Body, health, care, family, and intimacy
domains.applicability: every person; caregivers and dependants keep separate standing
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: critical if left open — care is where private power concentrates unseen
domains.consequence: unrouted care questions default to family obligation or state absence
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for the family, care, reproduction, and end-of-life rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: The health and care floor items; fiduciary, scoped, challengeable parent and caregiver powers; separation only on individualized serious-harm evidence; reproductive bodily authority throughout pregnancy; current informed treatment choice controls, including refusal of life-sustaining care; palliative care guaranteed; domestic privacy does not shelter violence or captivity.

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Medically assisted dying is democratically permissible, neither guaranteed nor prohibited; compensation regulation for gestational agreements; care-programme design above the floor.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::## 10. Ageing, treatment, and end of life

protected_private_civic.answer: Voluntary care, domestic production, intimacy, and family form are protected from prescription and outcome certification; marriage carries no constitutional privilege by itself; no family or household is presumed to supply the floor.

book2_operations.answer: Childcare, family proceedings, adoption, reproductive, fertility, birth, disability-support, respite, palliative, and assisted-dying service capacity, staffing, costs, and workflows.

external_assumptions_note.answer: Clinical findings, consent evidence, and death records arrive as bounded authenticated findings; their production is outside the engine (FS-EXA-03).

scenario_applicability.answer: Care, treatment, reproduction, and household-protection scenarios exercise this domain's ordinary, failure, continuity, remedy, and recovery registers, and the parent-child and scarcity collisions stress its floor interfaces; execution follows the family and economic rulings' contract cards.

domains.reader_destination: The floor chapter's care and health items today; the family and care chapters arrive with their rule families.

domains.title: Learning, knowledge, media, science, religion, and culture
domains.applicability: every person; communities hold separate cultural protections
domains.status: seeded-stage-1; routing complete at domain grain
domains.severity: serious if left open — the one non-carceral delivery route lives here
domains.consequence: learning stays the only floor actuality with a non-carceral route and nothing else joins it
domains.closure_condition: contract cards complete for learning delivery, culture, and expression rule families

constitutional_invariants.answer: The learning and expression floor items; teaching plus hearing derives learning without ranking the learner; recognition for teaching is unconditional and never ranked; minority culture, language, education, and media protections; internal cultural selection bounded by universal rights.
refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::## 13. Membership, internal government, and individual rights

ordinary_law_choices.answer: Curriculum, institutions, subsidy, and cultural programme design above the floor; statutory knowledge exclusivity remains time-bounded and must yield through a compatible access route chosen by democratic law.

protected_private_civic.answer: Belief, worship, culture, expression, and inquiry are protected; no state certification of a successful intellectual or spiritual life; delivery evidence may secure conditions but may not certify learning or belief.

legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent as a collective-rights interface; neighbouring architecture only:** general standing and association protections are incomplete, while federal locality and negotiated secession are author-ratified but unimplemented. No current relation establishes a people, minority, collective membership, customary institution, collective title, consultation, or consent.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: Protected Indigenous internal and local self-government, institutions, language, culture, education, collective land/resource title, participation, restitution, and remedy; minority culture, language, education, media, association, accessibility, anti-assimilation, and participation, with territorial authority only on independently established historical or territorial grounds; self-identification plus lawful collective acceptance, multiple membership, exit, privacy, and procedural challenge; internal selection and customary law bounded by universal individual rights and Constitutional Court review; actual collective consent for enumerated existential harms and temporary-evacuation protection of title; consultation, accommodation, reasons, and review for other material effects; one equal general-government ballot, common services, and no unilateral secession.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: No current collective-status, membership, institutional-authority, title, sacred-site, relocation, consent, consultation, customary-law, dissent, nonmember-resident, language-access, restitution, or assimilation rule family exists. Every effect must be split across standing, liberty, process, democratic choice, public institutions, records, jurisdiction, property, and commons rather than one omnibus `collective` predicate. Nibli may consume authenticated bounded findings but may not decide collective identity, membership, title, institutional action, or a generic tally; formal work must apply the completed finite collective-decision audit. Land/title administration, language services, consultation, staffing, costs, and workflows remain Book 2.
legacy_rows.legacy_status: Collective/plurality baseline author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.

legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent.** No current relation establishes a declaration, hazard, renewal, emergency measure, or end.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: A non-derogating overlay conferring exactly procedural acceleration, resource redirection, compensated requisition, and hazard-specific reviewable restriction. Named hazard, territory and powers, each separately justified; published reasons and evidence; cross-branch authorisation with a predeclared alternate authorising route and independent substitute reviewer; a fresh source-bound temporal contract per declaration and per renewal, each measure rejoining the exact declaration version; judicial review of existence and of every measure; restoration, post-hoc audit and remedy on end.
legacy_rows.legacy_status_cell: **Absent; the no-derogation emergency baseline is author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.**
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: There is no derogation clause: an emergency suspends no right, institution, election, or remedy, and creates no standing power between declarations. Rationing runs through the ratified physical-scarcity contract rather than becoming a new power; compulsory continuity keeps its narrow ratified form; price control is ordinary economic law needing no declaration. The polarity is the **same** as the custody gate — current authority is a positive premise — and the case-bound custody contract still cannot be reused. Fail-safe evidence rules defeat a renewal never made, **not a frozen or replayed record**, and Book 1 cannot make an emergency end. Book 2 owns response operations.
legacy_rows.legacy_status: Absent; the no-derogation emergency baseline is author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.

legacy_rows.domain_title: Public safety, policing, and use of force
legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent as a protective interface.** Conviction, placement and custody exist, but no relation establishes a protective mandate, an arrest, a search, a seizure, a pre-trial detention, or a use of force.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: Policing for harm rather than order as such, with a presumption against coercion and an identification-and-reasons duty. Complete contracts for arrest, pre-trial detention, search and seizure, including prompt **automatic** independent judicial review of detention. A force test of strict necessity, least harmful means, minimum sufficiency, warning where feasible, cessation and aid, with the burden of lawfulness on the public actor and lethal force only where strictly unavoidable to protect life. Independent investigation of every death and serious injury by a body other than the deploying one; no orders defence; command responsibility.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: "arrest", "habeas", "pre-trial" and "search and seizure" appear nowhere in the current record. `capture` means *documented*, not arrested — its consumers are credibility voiding and recognition — so arrest needs its own name. Every new coercive instrument sits **outside** the floor firewall, which reaches the confinement conclusion only, and must carry its own upstream-of-personhood rule plus a per-floor-predicate refusal pin. The deprivation stays a leaf; the instrument need not. Force capability, training, equipment, forensics and case administration are Book 2.

legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: A permitted but not required standing force with an **external-only** mandate under civilian command; an Assembly-held ceiling on size and armament; ordinary appropriation with full audit access; no jurisdiction over civilians; unarmed, individually authorised civil assistance carrying no police power. Prior Assembly authorisation for force abroad naming objective, basis, scope, geography, means and reporting; an immediate defensive response ending absent ratification. Refusal of delegated private coercion, mercenaries and paramilitaries; evidenced arms-transfer control; unconditional humanitarian duties; no person below legal adulthood recruited or used in hostilities.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: Aggressive and secret war are refused inside the corridor. A cyber or infrastructure attack may constitute an armed attack where scale and effects are equivalent, with evidenced attribution. The external-only mandate means the republic holds **no military instrument against a unilateral exit**. Capability, readiness, doctrine, procurement and sustainment are Book 2; other states' cooperation is a named external assumption.

legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: The narrowest protective mandate with the heaviest controls: no mass, bulk, suspicionless or population-scale collection, and no acquisition by purchase, partnership or foreign exchange of what could not lawfully be collected. Prior individualised judicial authorisation on evidenced suspicion of a specific serious harm, least intrusive effective means, defined subject/scope/duration, fresh authorisation per renewal, later notification, and challenge. Separately appointed oversight with its own budget, staff, unrestricted access including classified material, publication power and a duty to report; a protected-disclosure route.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: The 2026-08-02 temporary-assessment exclusion is extended **by name**: no risk, threat, loyalty, dangerousness, clearance or watchlist product enters the canonical consequential person record or conditions standing, floor, personhood, franchise, liberty, remedy or allocation. Secret evidence is never sole or decisive; where disclosure is impossible the consequence does not follow. Tradecraft, systems and information security are Book 2.

legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent.** `travel` is a movement conclusion, not a border interface.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: Everyone within the republic's jurisdiction or effective control is **owed** standing, the material floor, due process and remedy regardless of status. Absolute non-refoulement and a ban on collective expulsion; asylum as a right to fair determination with advocate, interpreter and suspensive appeal; individual reasoned expulsion decisions; no immigration detention of children and adult detention only on individualised necessity with judicial authorisation, a maximum and a real alternative; statelessness prevention. An **enforcement firewall** covering enrolment as well as collection and transmission. Extradition, mutual legal assistance and transfer of a person under individual judicial decision, suspensive appeal, and an express categorical-refusal bar.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: Written as a duty and a limit on power, not as a record claim: a person never entered is not recorded as missing, so no power may condition help on a record entry or treat an absent entry as a finding. Effective control, not formal territory, is the test — pushbacks, evasive externalised processing and jurisdiction-shopping are refused. A scarcity finding's **named population includes everyone within jurisdiction or effective control**, and nationality, citizenship, immigration status, documentation and manner of entry join the forbidden priority keys. The ratified return right is untouched and creates no nonresident ballot. Reception, processing and non-custodial-alternative operations are Book 2.

legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent.** No current relation establishes an environmental right, protected ecological condition, ceiling, guardian, breach, restoration duty, or ecological remedy.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: Dual protection: every present person holds a clean, healthy, and sustainable-environment right, while climate, air, waters, soils, biodiversity, ecosystems, land's ecological functions, and hazardous-waste and extraction effects are protected as commons for their intrinsic and intergenerational value. The environmental right is a liberty/equality/public-duty interface, **not** another material-floor predicate or a guaranteed personal outcome. Commons receive a directly enforceable qualitative non-destruction ceiling; science-bound ordinary law supplies reviewable quantitative standards. Precaution, cumulative effects, functional non-regression, avoidance/minimisation/restoration, tiered liability, independent initiation by any present person, qualified association, rights advocate, or the independently checked Future Conditions Guardian, with no joint-claimant requirement, environmental information/participation, and individual/systemic/ecological remedy apply.
legacy_rows.legacy_status_cell: **Ecological, future-generation, and commons baseline author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.**
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: No numeric ceiling, monitoring result, causal finding, or guardian act exists today. Ecosystems and future generations are protected interests and conditions, not `person` or Class-1 holders; the guardian represents no presumed unborn preference and creates no fetal or embryonic standing. Only the collegial Guardian—or its predeclared alternate advocate acting in its place—may trigger the bounded automatic pause on an irreversible authorisation; other independent initiators may request judicial interim relief. The Guardian has no final policy veto. Physical title never defeats the common ecological function, while conservation cannot erase Indigenous title or the existing consent boundary. Book 2 owns measurement, models, budgets, standards operation, transition, restoration capacity, and feasibility. Nibli may consume bounded authenticated findings but may not measure ecology, calculate a ceiling, establish causation, or prove institutional action.
legacy_rows.legacy_status: Ecological, future-generation, and commons baseline author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.

legacy_rows.legacy_coverage: **Absent.** No current relation establishes an animal, sentience, custody, welfare condition, prohibited harm, permitted use, advocate, inspection, rescue, or remedy.
legacy_rows.legacy_scope_requirement: Direct protection of an individual non-human animal on the basis of sentience or credible evidence of sentience, without human personhood. Prohibit deliberate cruelty, severe avoidable suffering, extreme avoidable deprivation, abandonment, inhumane killing, and dispensable killing; require species-appropriate care where a human controls the animal. Democratic law may permit companionship, work, conservation, farming, fishing, hunting, food, research, and other uses only inside the non-waivable welfare and ecological baseline. Any controlled use of a credibly sentient animal to produce food, including nonlethal or non-severe production, is lawful only where no safe, accessible, nutritionally adequate, materially less-harm route exists. Research requires replacement, reduction, and refinement and categorically refuses unrelieved severe or prolonged suffering. Every lethal, invasive, or high-severity use additionally needs a compatible purpose, necessity, proportionality, harm minimisation, and independent review. A separate Animal Protection Advocate and public bodies receive independent initiation and rescue routes. The animal's direct protected status and the prohibitions on severe avoidable suffering and dispensable killing are inside the democratic corridor. Species, populations, and habitat remain Class 9 commons questions; individual welfare belongs to Class 10.
legacy_rows.legacy_gap: Animal protection creates neither `person`, a human floor, ballot, candidacy, nor a total duty to eliminate predation, disease, or other natural suffering. The direct duty binds custodians, users, enterprises, and public power without converting human private relations into general horizontal effect. Cultural or religious practice receives ordinary liberty protection but no severe-cruelty exemption. Book 2 owns welfare measurement, husbandry, inspection, veterinary/rescue capacity, habitat operation, staffing, costs, and feasibility. Nibli may consume bounded authenticated animal-category, sentience, welfare-breach, licence, or review findings but may not discover sentience, assess suffering, authenticate an inspection, or perform rescue.
legacy_rows.legacy_status: Non-human-animal baseline author-ratified on 2026-08-08 but unimplemented.

routes.closure_condition: stays built; its controls stay watched failing
routes.warrants: Executable engine results over the exact current source or a named bounded mutation
routes.cannot_warrant: Anything about the world: arrival, operation, feasibility, or authentication
routes.falsification_condition: A pin, counterfactual, or staged execution that must fail when its guarded property is broken
routes.negative_control: Scoped-accept controls, counterfactual fixtures, and per-generator structural mutants are watched failing on every full run

routes.consequence: no modelled claim is possible today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, source-bound checker, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: Model results for their stated assumptions and envelope, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Formal entailment, operation, or reader experience
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: Dynamic simulations
routes.applicability: future simulated claims bound to the envelope
routes.consequence: no simulated claim is possible today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, source-bound checker, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: Simulation results for their stated dynamics and envelope, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Formal entailment, operation, or reader experience
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: The claim registry
routes.applicability: empirical figures about the world with provenance
routes.closure_condition: stays built; pinned-source entries stay human re-cited
routes.warrants: That a figure matches its named source at its retrieval date; staleness for script-refreshable entries
routes.cannot_warrant: Truth of the source, or anything about this design
routes.falsification_condition: A schema violation or a stale fetchable entry must fail the registry gate
routes.negative_control: The staleness gate's failure path is the route's control; the split is by name — script-refreshable entries gate on staleness, pinned-source entries are schema-checked and human re-cited

routes.title: Operational assurance
routes.applicability: future arrival, delivery, and operation claims
routes.severity: critical — the only route that can carry an arrival claim
routes.consequence: every liveness claim is Unestablished today
routes.closure_condition: evidence contract, admissibility criteria, source-bound checker, and in-repo gate exist
routes.warrants: That a staffed, accountable route was exercised end to end in a named envelope, once available
routes.falsification_condition: not-yet-declared — a reason the route is unbuilt, not an exemption

routes.title: Reader and lived-experience studies
routes.applicability: comprehension, balance, and human effects for the tested audience
routes.severity: material — optional reader evidence; no project gate depends on it
routes.closure_condition: not pursued in the current Book 1 program; after a later author revival, the implemented contract and fixed structural checker must validate, including history_transition binding to the nearest earlier normal first-parent reader-source change, exact previous source bytes and history head, preserved attempt prefixes and terminal attempts, one domain and one legal step, and exact predecessor_attempt_sha256 and prior_history_head_sha256 pre-registration bindings; the active pilot attempt must be valid with its seeded control watched failing; the threshold rule must be author-ratified; the fixed executable evidence-admission gate must pass self-test; and an externally custodied reviewer attestation must bind that gate's exact digest and closed review scope
routes.warrants: Comprehension, balance, and human effects for the tested audience within the disclosed sampling and method limits, once available
routes.cannot_warrant: Population statistics, authority over the people studied, resistance to rewritten Git history, external custody truth, or any legal or empirical claim
routes.falsification_condition: Declared by the reader-evidence protocol decision: the instrument must fail a seeded unbalanced or planted-misconception control, watched failing during the pilot's revise step; not yet shipped
routes.negative_control: not-yet-shipped — declared but unbuilt; the declaration does not make the route available

routes.title: Repository source-derived adversarial audit
routes.applicability: scope-map and assurance-program structural audit for Gate A
routes.severity: critical - Gate A requires exact current-source audit coverage
routes.consequence: repository structure, declared criteria, Gate-A defect coverage, and watched-failing mutations are reproducibly checked
routes.closure_condition: the current-source repository audit is present and exact; external human review remains optional evidence and is never a project gate
routes.warrants: That the named source version passes the declared structural, reference-closure, projection, allocation, defect-disposition, and watched-failing-mutation checks
routes.cannot_warrant: Independent-human review, reader response, external truth, operation, delivery, feasibility, liveness, calibration, timeless completeness, or authentication of the audit's own trust root
routes.falsification_condition: The route fails when the current audit drifts from the source or protocol digest, criteria, checker controls, command chain, finding set, result, or evidence ceiling, or when any watched mutation passes
routes.negative_control: The generator watches stale source/protocol bindings, criterion gaps, control or command drift, missing Gate-A findings, evidence-ceiling widening, and any unbuilt or available R7 relabelling

external_assumptions.title: Other states cooperate and recognise
external_assumptions.consequence: readmission, recognition, and cross-border protection depend on it
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — bounded per treaty and per case
external_assumptions.assumption: Other states' cooperation, recognition, readmission, and compliance are named external assumptions, not derived facts and not Book 2 deliverables.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: The dependent duty stays owed and its restrictive conclusions withhold; nothing manufactures the outside act.

external_assumptions.title: An outside clock advances
external_assumptions.consequence: windows, renewals, and emergencies depend on supplied time evidence
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — Book 2 operates clocks and time services
external_assumptions.assumption: The constitution cannot make a clock advance or prove that an outside clock advances; every temporal effect rides on supplied, witnessed time evidence.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: Current authority fails to derive and restrictive conclusions withhold; absence never manufactures freedom or an election.

external_assumptions.title: A required record or witness arrives
external_assumptions.consequence: carries, reviews, findings, and receipts all ride on record production
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — production, authentication, and persistence are outside the engine
external_assumptions.assumption: Witness production, successor records, authenticated findings, and receipt entries are produced outside the model; the repository cannot detect deletion before or inside the first attested record.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: A person never entered is not recorded as missing; no power may treat an absent entry as a finding, and help may not be conditioned on a record entry.

external_assumptions.title: A reviewer or institution actually acts
external_assumptions.applicability: every duty, alarm, and review endpoint
external_assumptions.consequence: nothing reads obliged; the chain ends at a named duty
external_assumptions.closure_condition: never internal — operational assurance could evidence action in a named envelope
external_assumptions.assumption: That a named reader, reviewer, or institution acts on a derived duty or alarm is assumed, never derived; a duty or an alarm is not evidence that anyone acted.
external_assumptions.failure_consequence: The breach of the duty is also markable, and what runs out is not links but anybody who has to act — stated in print.

roles.title: Person at first contact
roles.applicability: a newborn, an undocumented or unregistered person, anyone at first encounter with public functions; standing precedes any record, help is never conditioned on a record entry, and the person keeps petition, advocate, and challenge routes from the first moment
roles.consequence: help conditioned on a record entry
roles.closure_condition: the personhood and life-course contract cards land

power_positions.note: entry and status determinations reach a person before any record exists; serve first, reconcile the record afterwards
first-contact protective encounters reach the unregistered; no power may treat an absent record entry as a finding

roles.floor_invariance: the floor is owed to everyone within jurisdiction or effective control; `person` is writable and derivable — the settled mixed case — and no registration gate stands between the person and what they are owed

roles.title: Child
roles.applicability: every born child as an independent rights-holder, heard without a minimum speaking age, with increasing decision-specific authority, accessible support, and the child's own confidential help and challenge routes
roles.consequence: the child becomes an object of adult power
roles.closure_condition: the family rule families land; mature replaced

power_positions.note: protective intervention reaches the child only on individualized serious-harm or neglect evidence with support before removal
family proceedings decide separation and continuity; the child is heard in them

roles.floor_invariance: the child holds the same unconditional floor as every adult; being taught is not a contribution and the child is never graded, while a child who contributes is recognised
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::No minimum speaking age controls the right to be heard

roles.title: Adult
roles.applicability: every person from the one uniform statutory age; status arises automatically, records evidence it but do not create it, and disputed or missing evidence cannot create a gap or indefinite childhood
roles.consequence: a writer-controlled gate upstream of the franchise
roles.closure_condition: mature is replaced by the automatic adulthood contract

power_positions.note: registration and roll administration evidence adulthood and membership; they never create or remove either

roles.floor_invariance: adulthood adds the equal ballot and full legal agency on top of a floor the person already held as a child
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Acquisition is automatic when the lawful age threshold is reached

roles.title: Ageing person
roles.applicability: every person as they age, keeping home, community, legal agency, property, privacy, political membership, and bodily authority; age is never read as capacity, and the person keeps voice, supporters of their choosing, and challenge routes
roles.consequence: status-based erosion of agency in late life
roles.closure_condition: the ageing and supported-agency contract cards land

power_positions.note: care and provision decisions reach the ageing person without displacing their current choice

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Ageing creates no automatic loss of home

roles.floor_invariance: no automatic loss attaches to age; the floor never becomes conditional on residence setting or diagnosis
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Ageing creates no automatic loss of home

roles.title: Succession participant
roles.applicability: testators, successors, estate dependants, and bereaved people; a valid will leads subject to bounded dependant claims, and every participant keeps standing, floor access, and a challenge route during the dispute
roles.consequence: a dispute that interrupts the floor
roles.closure_condition: the succession contract cards land

power_positions.note: succession disputes are adjudicated; the dispute cannot interrupt the floor or evict a dependant without the housing-continuity process

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::A valid will leads the distribution of an estate

roles.floor_invariance: no floor item passes through an estate; succession moves property, never standing, office, guilt, or debt beyond the estate
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::A valid will leads the distribution of an estate

roles.title: Dependant and supported person
roles.applicability: every person receiving care or using decision support; keeps an independent entitlement, confidential help route, advocate, privacy, property claim, voice, and exit, and chooses, refuses, or changes supporters
roles.consequence: supported agency collapsing into substituted decision
roles.closure_condition: the supported-agency rule families land; plenary guardianship stays refused

power_positions.note: public continuity is immediate and non-delegable; no family, household, or charity is presumed to supply the floor
an advocate can act for the person; representation may never erase the person's own voice
the person chooses, refuses, and changes supporters and advocates; silence is never consent

roles.floor_invariance: dependency never merges two people's floors; one person's dependency cannot erase another person's rights
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Plenary guardianship and status-based removal of legal agency are

roles.title: Caregiver
roles.applicability: every person giving care, paid or unpaid, chosen or factual; keeps an independent floor, bodily integrity, privacy, rest, respite, income protection, and a route to relinquish or change an unsustainable role safely
roles.consequence: the caregiver's own floor dissolving into the role
roles.closure_condition: the care and delivery rule families land

power_positions.note: worker status attaches where actual control and dependency establish work, whatever the label

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::independent floor, bodily integrity, privacy, rest, respite

source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::independent floor, bodily integrity, privacy, rest, respite

roles.title: Decision supporter
roles.applicability: a supporter or chosen representative for a supported adult; explains, communicates, assists, and records — support never silently becomes substituted choice
roles.consequence: support hardening into plenary authority
roles.closure_condition: the supported-agency rule families land

power_positions.note: appointment, scope, and any best-interpretation route are decision-specific, time-bounded, and independently reviewed

roles.floor_invariance: the supporter's role gives no claim on the supported person's floor, property, or ballot; no guardian ballot exists

power_held.power: Decision support and representation over a supported adult. Any best-interpretation route is conflict-free, decision-specific, least-restrictive, time-bounded, and independently reviewed; an earlier support record is never a reusable capacity score.

roles.title: Holder of parentage
roles.applicability: every legal parent, including more than two by prior intent, adoption, or an adjudicated child-continuity finding; powers are fiduciary, scoped, challengeable, and reviewable, and imprisonment alone ends no parentage relation
roles.consequence: ownership readings of parentage
roles.closure_condition: the family rule families land; absence-based kinship independence replaced

power_positions.note: separation requires individualized serious-harm evidence, support before removal, and the least disruptive effective response

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Parentage is responsibility and relationship, never ownership

roles.floor_invariance: the child's floor and standing are independent of the parent's status, conviction, poverty, or family form
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Parentage is responsibility and relationship, never ownership

power_held.power: Parental authority over a child — responsibility and relationship, never ownership; best interests are a primary consideration, never an adult veto, and the child is heard.
power_held.source_ref: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::Parentage is responsibility and relationship, never ownership

roles.title: Household member
roles.applicability: every person in a chosen or factual living arrangement, including living alone; pooling is protected and voluntary, and each member keeps separate standing, floor access, voice, privacy, help, and exit
roles.consequence: the household absorbing the person
roles.closure_condition: unary family retired; home split by legal effect

power_positions.note: local housing and household rules reach the arrangement without merging its members' rights

roles.floor_invariance: the floor stays individual inside any household; no member's access depends on another's compliance, and domestic privacy does not shelter violence, captivity, or obstruction of help

roles.title: Patient
roles.applicability: every person receiving or refusing care; current informed choice controls, including refusal of life-sustaining care, palliative care is guaranteed, and the person keeps advocate and challenge routes in any care setting
roles.consequence: treatment authority displacing current choice
roles.closure_condition: the care delivery and consent rule families land

power_positions.note: care provision reaches the patient as delivery of what is owed, never as authority over the person's choice

roles.floor_invariance: no rule certifies health against the person's will; a chart can inform care and can never void standing

roles.title: Pregnant person
roles.applicability: every pregnant person; controls continuation and termination throughout pregnancy, free of coercion, discrimination, punishment, and third-party authorization, with confidential care and challenge routes
roles.consequence: third-party authorization over a body
roles.closure_condition: the reproductive-care contract cards land

power_positions.note: reproductive care is provided without gatekeeping; no agreement or office controls the bodily decision

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::The pregnant person controls whether to continue or terminate

roles.floor_invariance: no embryo or fetus outranks the pregnant person's authority, and pregnancy outcomes never become evidence against them
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-family-dependency-reproduction-and-collective-plurality-decision.md::The pregnant person controls whether to continue or terminate

roles.title: Learner
roles.applicability: every person learning at any age; the learner is heard, never ranked, and being taught is not a contribution — while teaching that delivers learning is the design's one non-carceral route to a floor actuality
roles.consequence: learning delivery certified by the provider's own word
roles.closure_condition: the accessibility-neutral delivery and receipt rule families land

power_positions.note: schooling and learning provision reach the learner as unconditional delivery, with accessibility-neutral receipt evidence still to land

roles.floor_invariance: learning derives from two-sided arrival evidence without grading anyone; the entitlement is unconditional and no maturity test gates either door

roles.title: Creator

roles.closure_condition: the knowledge-exclusivity contract cards land

roles.floor_invariance: no exclusivity may block a floor or commons duty; recognition of creative work stays non-ranked and non-operative

roles.title: Believer, worshipper, and non-believer
roles.applicability: every person holding, practising, changing, or refusing belief; protected from prescription, outcome certification, and scoring, with free exit and undiminished common rights and services

roles.closure_condition: the protected-voluntary-sphere contract cards land

roles.floor_invariance: belief is never a floor condition in either direction; the record holds no worship ledger and no rule prices a creed

roles.title: Friend, intimate partner, and mutual-aid participant
roles.applicability: every person in friendship, intimacy, mutual aid, gifts, and pooling; a pure non-prescription disposition — protected from prescription and certification, with public protection available on evidenced coercion, captivity, or obstruction of help

roles.closure_condition: the residual-free-field disposition cards land

roles.floor_invariance: no relationship is presumed to supply another person's floor, and privacy does not shelter violence or economic captivity; the four-part harm check — rights harm, concentrated power, public duty, commons effects — rides with the residual free field

roles.title: Worker
roles.applicability: every person whose actual control, dependency, and integration establish work, whatever the contract label; keeps association, bargaining, collective action, refusal and exit routes, and custody work stays voluntary with ordinary protection

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-economic-pluralism-and-protected-private-sphere-decision.md::Worker status follows actual control, dependency, integration

roles.floor_invariance: work, contribution, and compliance never gate standing, the floor, membership, or remedy; people may choose, refuse, leave, and change work without losing the floor
source_refs: new-book-plans/book-1-economic-pluralism-and-protected-private-sphere-decision.md::Worker status follows actual control, dependency, integration

roles.title: Person outside employment
roles.applicability: every person not in employment — by choice, exclusion, incapacity, or season of life; keeps the whole floor, standing, ballot, and remedy, and owes no participation in exchange

roles.closure_condition: the delivery and receipt rule families land

ordinary law binds the person only inside the corridor; no majority may condition the floor on work

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-constitutional-coverage-map.md::A person refuses work or lacks contribution history

roles.floor_invariance: the floor derives from personhood alone; refusal of work subtracts nothing

roles.title: Union member and collective-action participant

roles.closure_condition: the collective-labour contract cards land; the union finance card stays open

collective action and bargaining contest labour administration and employer power

roles.floor_invariance: no strike, refusal, or membership choice reaches the floor; individual refusal is never criminalized

roles.title: Tenant and dweller

power_positions.note: local housing rules reach the dwelling
eviction runs through a hearing with continuity; informality does not erase the claim

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-economic-pluralism-and-protected-private-sphere-decision.md::The housing floor guarantees an adequate secure dwelling

roles.title: Owner and property holder

roles.closure_condition: the property and acquisition contract cards land

power_positions.note: taxation reaches lawful holdings; collection cannot make a person floorless

refs: new-book-plans/book-1-economic-pluralism-and-protected-private-sphere-decision.md::Possession, use, transfer, and inheritance are protected conditional

current_source.text: For the power-specific T3 template, current source is limited to the cited temporal rule: Each power names its own authenticated current source and version.

scope.text: For the power-specific T3 template, scope is limited to the cited temporal rule: The temporal record binds only the exact power, person or protected object, case, legal effect, and source version.

review.text: For the power-specific T3 template, review is limited to the cited temporal rule: Review tests current source, scope, replay, renewal, correction, and end independently of the holder.

renewal_or_end.text: For the power-specific T3 template, renewal or end is limited to the cited temporal rule: Renewal requires a fresh source; absence, expiry, invalidation, or an unratified alternate ends authority.

challenge.text: For the power-specific T3 template, challenge is limited to the cited temporal rule: Affected people and authorised representatives may challenge source, currency, scope, replay, renewal, and end.

fail_closed_polarity.text: For the power-specific T3 template, fail closed polarity is limited to the cited temporal rule: Missing or non-current positive authority withholds the power; it does not manufacture the opposite fact.

scenarios.title: An election is called, run, challenged, and certified

scenarios.recovery_route: Challenge and recount run before certification consumes the result; the electoral administration answers to audit for the pipeline.

scenarios.failure_route: Absence of relief or review holds the person, and that cost is recorded as the design's own; secret process is refused.
scenarios.recovery_route: Appeal, forgiveness, and correction routes stand — the relief pair is case-unbound by ruling, and case-bound relief is the justice interface's closure condition; release is an act, never an expiry, and its absence is a recorded failure.

stopping_rule.materiality_test: A proposal is material when accepting it could change a declared right, liberty, power, duty, protected private boundary, cross-domain dependency, ordinary-life account, failure/recovery path, or adequacy, accessibility/equality, continuity, resilience, sustainability, safety, or resource criterion.
stopping_rule.boundary: Exhaustive may describe the disposition map only for the named axes above, a named source version, a named envelope, and a named current-source repository audit. This is versioned exhaustiveness for those declared axes, not a timeless completeness theorem, and disclosure alone does not cure a critical gap.
stopping_rule.no_hiding_rule: No critical unresolved defect affecting a gate's permitted claim may be hidden by classification, assignment, disclosure, or a stopping-rule decision.

severity_rubric.critical: Accepting the proposal would falsify the gate's permitted claim — a scope or assurance omission. An unresolved critical item blocks the affected gate even when it has an owner or has been disclosed, and a checked post-closure critical classification reopens Gate A.
severity_rubric.material: Material under the ratified materiality test, without falsifying the gate's permitted claim. A material item receives an author disposition and checker-enforced source-consistency review; retention as a limit creates or joins a stable defect row.
severity_rubric.minor: The editorial band: no record change and no materiality under the test. Recorded reasons suffice; no severity machinery attaches.
severity_rubric.confirmation_basis: Author statement, 2026-08-09: "I have reviewed. I can confirm it is good to proceed" — given in answer to the direct question whether the confirmation includes the candidate severity rubric's three class definitions and their binding to the materiality test; answered: yes, rubric confirmed. Recorded in the repo's convention for author acts: the statement quoted verbatim, the question it answered named.

criteria.name: Adequacy
criteria.definition: A floor condition counts as delivered only on independent recipient-side evidence of timely, accessible, adequate real access; a payment that cannot procure the good is not delivery.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Accessibility / equality
criteria.definition: Access is a proactive, systemic duty read against the responsible institution as a whole, with an effective alternative and public continuity route wherever a provider cannot serve.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet (equity and accessibility)

criteria.name: Continuity
criteria.definition: Public continuity is immediate and non-delegable when a private arrangement fails, is refused, or is exited; withdrawal, dispute, inaccessibility, inadequacy, or failure activates it.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Resilience
criteria.definition: Under every shock member the design states what continues, what narrows, who may decide, who is protected first, what cannot be suspended, how review arrives, and how ordinary authority is restored — and no right, institution, election, or remedy is suspended.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Sustainability
criteria.definition: Protected ecological axes are non-substitutable and may not be collapsed into one sustainability, productivity, or social-value score; ceilings are democratic law inside an independently reviewed scientific envelope.
provenance: the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet

criteria.name: Resource
criteria.definition: Genuine physical scarcity preserves each person's equal constitutional minimum wherever supply allows and records every unmet portion as failure under the forbidden priority keys; budget choice and artificial withholding are never scarcity.

criteria.name: Safety
criteria.definition: Force is strictly necessary, least harmful, minimum, warned where feasible, stopped on achievement, and followed by aid, with the burden of lawfulness on the public actor and the categorical refusals absolute.
provenance: the boundary decision's materiality test — the seventh member, carried so no ratified criterion is dropped

functional_criteria.drift_note: The criteria list appears in five ratified variants: the mandate names adequacy, equality/accessibility, continuity, resilience, sustainability, and resource; the former Book 1 envelope tracker bullet names adequacy, continuity, equity, accessibility, resilience, and sustainability without resource; the boundary decision's materiality test adds safety; the book-2 mirror compounds them as accessibility/equity, continuity/reserve, recovery/resilience, ecological-sustainability, and fiscal/resource-feasibility; and the ledger's former threshold deferral named five, omitting sustainability. This canon is the union with provenance — no criterion any ratified text names is dropped — and the ledger's own materiality test is aligned in the same change to the boundary decision's exact wording.
